name: AmCham Singapore
summary: American Chamber of Commerce — policy briefings, sector committees, and professional networks for US-linked business in Singapore.
body: AmCham is the US business community’s institutional hub: policy briefings, sector committees, and large networking calendars (Shaw Centre office; see amcham.com.sg for live events). Belonging here is professional rather than family-sport — useful when you have BD targets or want committee visibility, expensive if you only show up for the holiday party. Young professionals seeking friends should trial one mixer then default to hobby sports or AAS community events rather than stacking dues. Corporate memberships dominate; verify individual/SME options and fee schedules live. Pair with the American Association for cultural soft landing, and with the chambers guide for a six-month ROI test.
membershipNotes: Corporate memberships dominate; individual options vary — check current fees before joining.
